offering_description.value: The company sells freight railcars and replacement parts to businesses that move bulk commodities and containerized cargo by rail. It designs and manufactures cars to customer requirements and rebuilds or converts existing cars.

quotes.quote: At FreightCar America, we specialize in premium railcars, conversions, rebodies and exceptional parts and service. By actively listening and learning, we consistently exceed your railcar needs, delivering reliable solutions with every interaction. Choose FreightCar America for unmatched excellence and dependability.

We design and manufacture durable steel, stainless steel, aluminum and hybrid steel-aluminum freight cars for a wide range of bulk commodities and containerized freight. Our expert team collaborates with you to deliver tailored railcar solutions. With a state-of-the-art facility, we produce over 20 conversion designs and an expanded portfolio, including open-top hoppers, covered hoppers, gondolas, flats, intermodal cars, boxcars and well cars (articulated and standalone).
